CustomField.description: Settings for referenceFieldOverrideType__c = recordpicker (#661): JSON object {"filter": {"criteria": [{"fieldPath", "operator", "value"}], "filterLogic"}, "displayInfo": {"primaryField", "additionalFields": [one]}, "matchingInfo": {"primaryField": {"fieldPath"}, "additionalFields": [{"fieldPath"}]}} in the shapes lightning-record-picker takes, edited through the Record Picker Settings modal in Form Builder. String filter values merge {{Field__c}} from the form record at runtime; a criterion whose merged value is blank is dropped and filterLogic is renumbered. Reaches metadata-sourced forms through Form_Field__mdt.config__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Filter, display and search settings for a lookup shown as a Record Picker, managed from the Record Picker Settings editor in Form Builder. Filter values can use merge fields from the form record, such as {{AccountId}}, to limit suggestions based on another answer.
CustomField.label: Record Picker Config
